_comment: EPISODE 1, TAKE B of three. The MIDDLE: three new people and the guesses get strange, which is where the gag has to develop. If the middle take repeats the opening's beat the episode dies at its own first join. product and location are IDENTICAL BYTE FOR BYTE with takes A and C; the question is reworded because an interviewer asking three people does not read the same sentence off a card, and because the identical line three times in one episode reads as a duplicated segment (the seed-4814 fault, which was real duplication and sounded exactly like this).
